buildCommand: node -e " const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); const root = fs.existsSync('SCEDULAR-BACKEND/package.json') ? process.cwd() : require('path').resolve(process.cwd(),'..'); console.error('[build] repo root detected:', root); process.chdir(root); cp.execSync('npm --prefix SCEDULAR-BACKEND run build 2>/dev/null || echo "backend build skipped"',{stdio:'inherit'}); cp.execSync('npm --prefix SCEDULAR-FRONTEND run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); "
